title: Chain on Demand: Deferred Evidence Organization for Long-Term Conversational Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.02480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term conversational memory faces a timing mismatch: write-time summaries and graphs organize history before a future query is known, while independent retrieval can allocate a limited evidence budget to redundant or fragmented turns. We introduce Chain on Demand (CoD), a query-time evidence organization framework over an unchanged turn-level memory. Given a broad candidate pool, CoD constructs a temporary evidence chain by allocating a fixed anchor budget according to query relevance, lexical diversity relative to selected anchors, and newly covered query terms, followed by deterministic restoration of each selected anchor's same-session neighborhood. The resulting chain is used only for the current query, while the underlying conversational memory remains unchanged. In a paired comparison over all 1,986 LoCoMo questions, CoD achieves 82.2% accuracy on 1,540 non-adversarial questions and 76.3% on all 1,986 questions. On LongMemEval-

translated_title: 按需链：面向长期对话记忆的延迟式证据组织
translated_abstract: 长期对话记忆面临一个时机错配问题：写入时的摘要和图结构会在未来查询未知的情况下预先组织历史，而独立检索则可能将有限的证据预算浪费在冗余或碎片化的对话轮次上。我们提出了按需链（Chain on Demand, CoD），这是一个在保持轮次级记忆不变的前提下、于查询时进行证据组织的框架。给定一个宽泛的候选池，CoD根据查询相关性、相对于已选锚点的词汇多样性以及新覆盖的查询词来分配固定的锚点预算，从而构建一条临时证据链，随后对每个被选中锚点的同会话邻域进行确定性恢复。所得的证据链仅用于当前查询，而底层对话记忆保持不变。在覆盖全部1,986个LoCoMo问题的配对比较中，CoD在1,540个非对抗性问题上达到82.2%的准确率，在全部1,986个问题上达到76.3%的准确率。在LongMemEval-（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出按需链（CoD）框架，将证据组织推迟到查询时刻进行，在不修改底层对话记忆的前提下动态构建临时证据链，在LoCoMo基准上显著提升了长期对话记忆问答的准确率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Chain on Demand (CoD), a query-time evidence organization framework that defers evidence organization until a query arrives, dynamically constructing temporary evidence chains without modifying the underlying conversational memory, significantly improving accuracy on the LoCoMo benchmark for long-term conversational memory QA.
